items.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: And you’d hear the popular singers, the classical singers of the day. Lilly Pons, Tibbitt I think his name was.

ctx.x: The Grant Park in Chicago. They used to have symphony concerts in the summer and free. And you’d sit there at the band shell and listen to the Chicago Symphony. And you’d hear the popular singers, the classical singers of the day. Lilly Pons, Tibbitt I think his name was.
